alert_news.title: Vande Bharat Crosses Chenab, Anji Bridges At 100 kmph As Katra‑Banihal Train Speed Limit Raised
bullets: First train to cross the world’s highest railway bridge (Chenab) and India’s first cable‑stayed railway bridge (Anji) at 100 km/h.
Speed test conducted on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising the maximum permissible speed from 75 km/h to 100 km/h.
Vande Bharat Express (train numbers 26401/26404) performed the run on 2 Oct 2025.

alert_news.title: Vande Bharat Express Sets First 100 kmph Run Across Chenab and Anji Bridges
bullets: First time a Vande Bharat Express crossed the world’s highest railway bridge (Chenab) and India’s first cable‑stayed railway bridge (Anji) at 100 km/h.
The speed test was on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising the maximum permissible speed from 75 to 100 km/h.

alert_news.title: India Launches First AI Satellite MOI‑1A; Space Image Processing Tech
bullets: India’s first orbital computing satellite, MOI‑1A, launched by Hyderabad‑based TechMeToSpace on SpaceX’s Transporter‑18 mission.
MOI‑1A is a 13‑kg, 6U satellite with 120‑W power that processes images and data in orbit using AI, sending only useful information to Earth.
This launch makes India the fourth country globally to possess orbital computing capability after the United States, the European Union and China.

alert_news.title: India's First Chief Election Commissioner and the First General Election
bullets: Sukumar Sen, appointed in 1950, was India's first Chief Election Commissioner and oversaw the creation of the first electoral rolls.
The first general election (1951‑52) registered 17.3 crore voters across a population of 36.5 crore, conducted without any digital technology.
This historic exercise established universal adult suffrage and laid the foundation for India's democratic governance.

alert_news.title: India’s first World Happiness Summit concludes in Bengaluru
bullets: India’s first World Happiness Summit held in Bengaluru on 29 September 2026, organized by Happpy AiR – Atman.

The summit convened personalities from entertainment, entrepreneurship, spirituality, wellness and social leadership to discuss happiness pillars: Pleasure, Peace, Purpose, aiming to make Bengaluru the world’s happiest city.

alert_news.title: India's First Ever Asian Games Gold in Trap Mixed Team Event
bullets: India won its first gold medal in the mixed trap team shooting event at the Asian Games, achieved by Neeru Dhanda and Kynan Chenai in Aichi-Nagoya 2026.
The duo scored 34, breaking the previous Games record of 30 set earlier that year.
This milestone marks India's inaugural gold in the newly introduced mixed trap team event.

alert_news.title: India's First General Election and Electoral Roll by Sukumar Sen
bullets: India’s first general election was held in 1951‑52 under the Election Commission led by Chief Election Commissioner Sukumar Sen, enrolling 17.3 crore voters.
The election was conducted without any digital technology, relying on manual roll creation and door‑to‑door registration.
It was the largest democratic exercise globally at the time, establishing universal adult suffrage in newly independent India.

alert_news.title: India wins first athletics gold at Asian Games 2026
bullets: Women’s 4×400 m relay team (Kiran, Machettira Poovamma, Prachi, Vithya Ramraj) secured India’s first athletics gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya.
Winning time 3:29.69, defeating Bahrain (silver) and China (bronze).
Marks first gold in track & field for India at Asian Games since 2018.

alert_news.title: Hyderabad-based TakeMe2Space to launch India's first orbital computing satellite on SpaceX Falcon 9
bullets: India's first orbital computing satellite (MOI-1A) to launch on SpaceX Falcon 9 in 2028.
Satellite carries Nvidia Orin NX edge‑computing processors; part of first networked orbital data centre mission.
Plan to deploy a constellation of six satellites, marking India's entry into orbital data centres.

alert_news.title: Shah launches India's first counter‑terrorism policy
bullets: India’s first unified National Counter‑Terrorism Policy and Strategy (PRAHAAR‑CT) launched by Union Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi.
Policy integrates central agencies, state police and other stakeholders under a single doctrine, introduces automated response mechanisms and an extradition portal.

alert_news.title: Women's 4x400m relay team clinch India's first athletics gold at Asian Games 2026
bullets: India’s first athletics gold medal at the Asian Games 2026 won by the women’s 4×400 m relay team (Kiran, Machettira Poovamma, Prachi, Vithya Ramraj) at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi.
The quartet clocked 3:29.69, topping Bahrain (3:30.21) and China (3:31.02).

alert_news.title: Sense India Inaugurates India's First Sensory Tunnel for Persons with Deafblindness
bullets: India’s first Sensory Tunnel for persons with deafblindness inaugurated at the Sparsh Centre, Thane, Maharashtra, by Sense International India with CSR support from Shipping Corporation of India Lands and Assets Limited (SCILAL).

The tunnel features five sensory zones—vision, tactile, vestibular, proprioceptive, auditory—providing structured sensory activities for children and young adults with deafblindness and multiple disabilities.

alert_news.title: India's First and Largest Student Space-Technology Fest – NSSC 2026
bullets: The National Students’ Space Challenge (NSSC), established in 2011, is India's first and largest student space-technology fest, organized by IIT Kharagpur under the Kalpana Chawla Space Technology Cell.
NSSC provides a national-level platform for students to explore space and space technology through competitions, research, engineering, creativity, and collaboration.
